description: Na₃P₃N₃H₅O₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2 space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with four PN₂O₂ tetrahedra and edges with three NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.61 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PN₂O₂ tetrahedra and edges with three NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.64 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PN₂O₂ tetrahedra and edges with three NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.78 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.52 Å. There are three inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to two N and two O atoms to form PN₂O₂ tetrahedra that share corners with four NaO₆ octahedra and corners with two PN₂O₂ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 52-65°. There is one shorter (1.69 Å) and one longer (1.70 Å) P-N bond length. Both P-O bond lengths are 1.51 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to two N and two O atoms to form PN₂O₂ tetrahedra that share corners with three NaO₆ octahedra and corners with two PN₂O₂ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 54-65°. There is one shorter (1.69 Å) and one longer (1.70 Å) P-N bond length. Both P-O bond lengths are 1.52 Å. In the third P site, P is bonded to two N and two O atoms to form PN₂O₂ tetrahedra that share corners with three NaO₆ octahedra and corners with two PN₂O₂ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 58-71°. There is one shorter (1.69 Å) and one longer (1.70 Å) P-N bond length. There is one shorter (1.51 Å) and one longer (1.53 Å) P-O bond length. There are three inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two P and one H atom. The N-H bond length is 1.02 Å. In the second N site, N is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two P and one H atom. The N-H bond length is 1.03 Å. In the third N site, N is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two P and one H atom. The N-H bond length is 1.03 Å. There are five inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.00 Å) and one longer (1.74 Å) H-O bond length. In the third H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one N atom. In the fourth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one N atom. In the fifth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one N atom. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to three Na and one P atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₃P tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to three Na and one P atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₃P tetrahedra. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one P, and one H atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two Na and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent H atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a water-like geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent H atoms.
